Weights behind the simple overall average treatment effect

Source: R/twfeweights.R
att_simple_weights.Rd

Computes the weights on each group-time average treatment effect, \(ATT(g,t)\), that deliver \(ATT^{simple}\), the average of all post-treatment \(ATT(g,t)\) weighted by group size (Callaway and Sant'Anna, 2021). This is the "simple" aggregation in did::aggte().

Usage

att_simple_weights(
  attgt_res,
  w = NULL,
  keep_untreated = FALSE,
  weightsname = attgt_res$DIDparams$weightsname
)

Arguments

attgt_res

The result of did::att_gt().

w

Optional external unit-specific weights, one per row of attgt_res$DIDparams$data. If NULL (the default), the weights come from weightsname.

keep_untreated

Logical. If TRUE, keep rows for the never-treated group (whose weights and \(ATT(g,t)\) are zero) in the results. Default is FALSE.

weightsname

Name of the column holding time-invariant sampling weights. Defaults to the weightsname passed to did::att_gt(). NULL means unweighted. Ignored if w is supplied.

Value

An object of class mp_weights_obj; see twfe_weights(). Here weight holds the \(ATT^{simple}\) weights.

Details

Each post-treatment cell \((g,t)\) gets weight proportional to \(P(G = g | G \neq 0)\); pre-treatment cells get zero. Because every post-treatment period counts once, groups treated earlier (observed for more post-treatment periods) get more total weight than under attO_weights().

References

Callaway, Brantly and Pedro H. C. Sant'Anna. "Difference-in-Differences with Multiple Time Periods." Journal of Econometrics 225.2 (2021). doi:10.1016/j.jeconom.2020.12.001

See also

twfe_weights(), attO_weights()

Examples

data(mpdta, package = "did")
attgt <- did::att_gt(
  yname = "lemp", tname = "year", idname = "countyreal",
  gname = "first.treat", data = mpdta,
  control_group = "nevertreated", base_period = "universal",
  bstrap = FALSE, cband = FALSE
)
ws <- att_simple_weights(attgt)
sum(ws$weights_df$weight * ws$weights_df$attgt)
#> [1] -0.03995128

# same as the simple aggregation in did
did::aggte(attgt, type = "simple", bstrap = FALSE)$overall.att
#> [1] -0.03995128
